business.description: K.C.P. Sugar and Industries Corporation Limited is engaged in the manufacture of sugar, incidental cogeneration power, industrial alcohol, ethanol, bio-fertilisers, carbon dioxide, calcium lactate, and processing of urad dal. outlook.statement: Future outlook depends on: opportunities in ethanol production as escalating ethanol price could prompt relatively lower cane mix for sugar; developing high breed varieties of sugarcane suitable for Indian climatic conditions and focus on vertical growth in sugarcane productivity; invention of suitable sugarcane harvesting machine for Indian soil conditions and operable in fragmented land holdings; sugar recovery should stay firm while product prices are expected to stay supportive; swift adaptation of new cultivation method suitable for mechanised harvesting; agro-climatic conditions in major sugar-producing States.
In respect of further integration of allied products, in the forthcoming year, the Company plans to absorb technology related to cyclones to work towards Self Reliant India.

risks: Raw Material Risk: Sugarcane availability disturbance impacts operational cost; market value does not factor variable cost determined by climatic conditions and cane economics
Policy Risk: Sugar industry highly regulated by Government of India with State Governments as monitoring agencies; performance depends on policy decisions
Cyclicality/Commodity Risk: Sugar price depends on cyclicality of sugar business and global supply-demand factors
Risk of surge in sugarcane prices and harvesting expenses
Rising fuel prices and inadequate tariff limiting standalone power production during off-season
Stressed finances and realization challenge for power dues
Rise in transportation costs affecting sugarcane growing and pricing
Cyclical nature of Sugar Industry and local climatic conditions affecting quantity and quality of sugar cane resulting in uncertain Production Output & Short crushing season
